verdict.rationale: Letta's Agent SDK documents first-party MCP client support. Tools are discovered from servers supplied through `mcpServers` and proxied to the MCP server, over stdio, Streamable HTTP and legacy SSE transports. Missing for 10: evidence of MCP server configuration in the CLI, desktop or web app (only the SDK surface is documented), details on auth and tool filtering, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: MCP tools are discovered from servers supplied through `mcpServers` and proxied by the SDK host to the MCP server.
The SDK supports local stdio processes, Streamable HTTP, and legacy SSE
The Agent SDK can expose two kinds of tools through your Node.js process
